shortBulletSummary: Crypto exchange Bitget reported a $352 million hot wallet breach on September 24, leading to a temporary pause in withdrawals.
Bitcoin spot ETFs recorded a net inflow of $191 million on September 24, with BlackRock's IBIT leading.
The Crypto Fear and Greed Index is currently at 54, reflecting a Neutral sentiment in the market.
Despite a recent Federal Reserve rate hike, Bitcoin quickly recovered above $84,000, signaling market resilience.
The market for tokenized Real World Assets (RWAs) showed continued strong momentum, growing to approximately $39 billion in Q3 2026.
